_note: Retreat-builder MCP tool (2026-10-20 extension pack). core.mjs TOOLS shape.

tools.description: Plan a personal retreat from an intent: topic, tradition/teacher (optional), days, strictness. Returns matched full talks (MMR across traditions), a scaled timetable, rules overlay, and flexibility notes. Nothing is booked; the user starts it with start_retreat.
tools.name: plan_retreat
tools.resolver: topic MMR talk match (full talks, tradition-weighted) + timetable scale by strictness + rules overlay + flexibility notes
tools.title: Plan a retreat
